facts.fact: After logging in, go to Services > Condonation request > Application for statutory Forms
facts.quote: Step 1: Go to the e-Filing portal homepage and Click on Login. Step 2: Enter the User ID and Password. Step 3: Go to Services > Condonation request > Application for statutory Forms.

facts.fact: Click + Create Condonation request (then Start new filing)
facts.quote: Step 4: Click on +Create Condonation request. If you want to view previously raised request, click on “View Details” Step 5: Click on Start new filing.

facts.fact: Fill in the condonation application form (taxpayer details, form details, attachments)
facts.quote: Step 6: Fill the Condonation application form: 1. Details of Taxpayer 2. Details of Form.
Step 7: Select mode of E-Verify and click continue. Step 8: After E-VERIFICATION your form will be submitted.

facts.fact: Note the transaction ID for future reference
facts.quote: After E-VERIFICATION your form will be submitted. Note the transaction ID for future reference.

summary: Form 10A condonation steps confirmed on the ITD user manual: Services > Condonation request > Application for statutory Forms, + Create, fill, e-verify, note transaction ID.
